questionGroups.html:
Questions 21–26

Who agrees with the following statements?

Write the correct letter, A, B or C, next to Questions 21-26.

21 The course needs more advertising services and academic support

22 The course outline is good

23 Other material is necessary for the course

24 The feedback on assignments is useful

25 The library's resources and room are not enough

26 The materials are insufficient due to the large number of students

A Amy only
B Mike only
C both Amy and Mike

Questions 27 and 28

Choose TWO letters, A-E.

Which TWO parts of the college should be improved?

Questions 29 and 30

Complete the notes below.

Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.

Improvement needed: more work recommended by the career office.
The help centre provides useful for students.

transcript.en: Hi Amy, it’s great we’re able to fill out this questionnaire.
transcript.zh: 嗨，艾米，很高兴我们能填写这份问卷了。

transcript.en: I’ve been wanting to give some feedback about the school for a while.
transcript.zh: 一段时间以来，我一直想给学校一些反馈。

transcript.en: That’s for sure! There are many things I would like to see changed.
transcript.zh: 当然！很多事情我都希望看到改变。

transcript.en: What about this question- ‘Does the course need more advertising services and academic support?’ What do you think?
transcript.zh: 看看这个问题——“课程需要更多的广告服务和学术支持吗？”你怎么看？

transcript.en: I’m not sure. I think our biology course is advertised well, it was one of the first options that came up when I was looking for courses to choose from.
transcript.zh: 我不确定。我认为我们的生物课程宣传得很好，它是我在寻找可供选择的课程时出现的第一批选择之一。

transcript.en: We have so many knowledgeable professors to provide academic support.
transcript.zh: 我们有很多知识渊博的教授提供学术支持。

transcript.en: I did an accounting unit last year, and the support was so much better than it is for this course.
transcript.zh: 我去年修了会计课程，这门课程的支持比课程本身好。

transcript.en: It seems scientific fields are not the focus of this school.
transcript.zh: 看来科学领域不是这所学校的重点。

transcript.en: There should be more support for the students and teachers, and it needs much more advertising.
transcript.zh: 应该给学生和老师更多的支持，需要更多的宣传广告。

transcript.en: What about the next question - what do you think of the course outline?
transcript.zh: 下一个问题呢——你觉得课程大纲怎么样？

transcript.en: I think it’s great! What we’re learning is interesting, and it will be of great benefit to me in my career as a biologist once we’ve graduated.
transcript.zh: 我认为很棒！我们正在学习的东西很有趣，一旦我们毕业，这将对我作为生物学家的职业生涯大有裨益。

transcript.en: I must say I feel the opposite. There’s not enough information on plant biology.
transcript.zh: 我的感觉正好相反。没有足够的植物生物学信息。

transcript.en: We focus too much on human biology and anatomy.
transcript.zh: 我们过分关注人类生物学和解剖学。

transcript.en: If you want to be an anatomist, then it’s beneficial, but I think they should give a more diverse coverage of the entire subject, not just one branch.
transcript.zh: 如果你想成为一名解剖学家，那当然是有益的，但我认为他们应该对整个学科有更多样化的覆盖，而不仅仅是一个分支。

transcript.en: Maybe. You feel that other material is necessary for the course?
transcript.zh: 也许吧。你觉得课程需要其他材料吗？

transcript.en: Definitely. We only cover a narrow field of information for such a broad subject, so we will need to look for some more material for this course.
transcript.zh: 当然。对于如此广泛的主题，我们只涵盖了一个狭窄的信息领域，所以我们需要为这门课程寻找更多的材料。

transcript.en: I believe our course has already got different aspects included.
transcript.zh: 我相信我们的课程已经包含了不同的方面。

transcript.en: There is no need for additional material.
transcript.zh: 不需要额外的材料。

transcript.en: With respect to the next question regarding feedback, I am grateful to our professors for the feedback they provide on our assignments.
transcript.zh: 关于反馈的下一个问题，我很感谢我们的教授对我们的作业提供的反馈。

transcript.en: It really helps a lot. I feel like I’m getting the most out of the course when they commend me for what I did well on and tell me where I can improve.
transcript.zh: 真的帮助很大。当他们称赞我做得很好并告诉我可以改进的地方时，我觉得我从课程中得到了最大的收获。

transcript.en: I do think so. At my previous school, we never heard back about how we performed on our assignments, so I would keep making the same mistakes because I didn’t understand that I wasn’t meeting requirements.
transcript.zh: 我也这么认为。在我以前的学校，我们从来没有听说过我们的作业表现如何，所以我会不断犯同样的错误，因为我不知道自己没有达到要求。

transcript.en: What’s your opinion regarding library resources?
transcript.zh: 你对图书馆资源有什么看法？

transcript.en: I believe the library resources could be improved upon. The books available haven’t changed for years.
transcript.zh: 我相信图书馆的资源可以改进。可用的书籍多年没有改变。

transcript.en: And the room available isn’t sufficient- it’s so crowded!
transcript.zh: 而且可用的空间不够——太拥挤了！

transcript.en: Yes, the room is not enough to hold all the students using it.
transcript.zh: 是的，空间不足以容纳所有使用它的学生。

transcript.en: It definitely needs renovating.
transcript.zh: 它肯定需要重新翻新。

transcript.en: This next question is interesting- ‘Are there sufficient materials to use for each class?’ I think it’s ok, but I know that many students would disagree.
transcript.zh: 下一个问题很有意思——‘每节课有足够的材料吗？’我觉得这方面还可以，但我知道很多学生会不同意。

transcript.en: We absolutely do not have enough materials to use. There are so many students that we have to share equipment.
transcript.zh: 我们绝对没有足够使用的材料。学生太多，以至于需要共享装备。

transcript.en: I had to share a microscope with several other people last week- it was very frustrating!
transcript.zh: 上周我不得不和其他几个人共用一台显微镜——这非常令人沮丧！

transcript.en: You obviously feel very strongly!
transcript.zh: 很明显你感受强烈！

transcript.en: Regarding the college in general, what do you believe should be improved?
transcript.zh: 对于大学，整体来看，你觉得有什么需要改进的地方？

transcript.en: I think that although the meeting room isn’t large, it’s sufficient.
transcript.zh: 我觉得会议室虽然不大，但也足够了。

transcript.en: That’s true, the sound effect in there is actually great. And the sports facilities work well as they are.
transcript.zh: 是的，里面的音效真的很棒。运动设施照旧运行良好。

transcript.en: It’s better than the equipment in the gym that I go to.
transcript.zh: 它比我去的健身房的设备要好。

transcript.en: They don’t even have enough dumbbells.
transcript.zh: 他们甚至没有足够的哑铃。

transcript.en: I am quite satisfied. And what about the dining room?
transcript.zh: 我很满意。餐厅呢？

transcript.en: I feel like you need to wait so long to get your lunch that you have no time left to eat it before the next class!
transcript.zh: 我觉得你需要等很长时间才能得到你的午餐，以至于你没有时间在下节课之前吃完！

transcript.en: I think they need to employ more staff in the catering department, to facilitate faster service.
transcript.zh: 我认为他们需要在餐饮部门雇用更多的员工，以提供更快的服务。

transcript.en: The student apartments are good. They’re so clean!
transcript.zh: 学生公寓很好。很干净！

transcript.en: But I don’t want to get sick one day only to find I must spend half the day waiting in the doctor’s office.
transcript.zh: 但我不想有一天生病却发现我必须花大半天的时间在医生办公室里等待。

transcript.en: The healthcare services provided at this school could be better.
transcript.zh: 这所学校提供的医疗保健服务原可以做得更好。

transcript.en: I’ll also mention the career office. All the jobs advertised there are for full-time positions, and most students don’t have the time for that.
transcript.zh: 还有职业办公室。广告上的所有职位都是全职职位，大多数学生都没有时间去做这些。

transcript.en: We already study full time. I’d like to see more part-time work advertised.
transcript.zh: 我们已经全日制学习了。我希望看到更多的兼职工作广告。

transcript.en: The help center is a great place. Useful training is available during one’s school years, through which we can gain more skills for our schoolwork, though it needs to be promoted more to benefit more students.
transcript.zh: 帮助中心很不错。在学年中提供有用的培训，通过它我们可以获得更多的学习技能，尽管它需要进一步提升以使更多的学生受益。

transcript.en: That’s true. It helps me take my mind off my stress.
transcript.zh: 是的。它帮助我摆脱了压力。

transcript.en: Well, I’ve completed my questionnaire. I’d better get to class- I’ll be late!
transcript.zh: 我已经完成了我的问卷调查。我得去上课了-要迟到了！

transcript.en: See you later!
transcript.zh: 待会见！
